description:
![](https://i.ibb.co/G7Lt1dF/mpv-shot0008.jpg)

**Please note this is a raw release. The final CHAP subbed release will take some time to restore before release.**

CHAP presents a raw release of "Mahou no Rouge Lipstick"! This release is sourced from the rare 2011 DVD of the program distributed at conventions by Usagi Marino.

You may notice that the video is a little bit...more like quite...choppy. This is not the fault of our encoding, but the fault of the person(s) responsible for mastering the 2011 DVD, as frames were lost and fields were interlaced incorrectly due to incorrect telecining and detelecining during the mastering process. The final CHAP release aims to correct some of the issues to an extent, but for now, we feel it is more important to release a raw of this super rare DVD containing a "classic" mahou shoujo parody. Video is uncensored as there's nothing super explicit anyway.

The DVD has some minor differences from the 1985 VHSrip that has been online forever, such as re-done ED credits, alternate titles in some places, and some minor editing differences (not for censorship reasons). Enjoy!

Raw .iso is available on the [Internet Archive](https://archive.org/details/lipstick_202209).

**Video/audio source:** 2011 DVD remaster
